'''Tech Team''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technical]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Assigned to the [[Hitak Harriers]], Tech Team participated in an effort to capture the [[Hammer 4:3]] [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] during the [[Battle of Turak IV]] alongside [[Red Squad (Hitak Harriers)|Red Squad]] and [[Green Squad (Hitak Harriers)|Green Squad]].<ref name="Hammer" />
